title: Pea Oregon Sugar Pod - 3x Mini Plug Plants - Mangetout/Snow Pea - Heavy Cropper
description:
Pea Plant: Mangetout/Snow Pea ‘Oregon Sugar Pod’ (Mini Plug Plants) x3


 Set of 3 mini plug plants of mangetout/sugar pea/snow pea ‘Oregon Sugar Pod’. Produces around 4 inch (10 cm) slightly curved, fleshy pods on vigorous, hardy vines (approx. 3 ft tall). High-yielding variety with good flavour, suitable for light steaming or stir-fries, and noted for holding its colour well. Typically crops in about 68 days (growing conditions can affect timing).


 Plant height (approx.)


  Up to 3 ft (about 90 cm)
 

 Growing notes


  Plant out once established and conditions are suitable
 

  Grow in a sunny position in moist, fertile, well-drained soil
 

  Keep weed-free and water as needed
 

  Provide support (netting/canes) as the plants grow
 

  Harvest when pods begin to swell
 

  Pick regularly to encourage continued cropping
 

 What you’ll receive


  3 x mini plug plants
